title: Open Mic & Karaoke @ Strummer's
event_description: Weekly open mic night from 7:30-9:00 PM followed by karaoke from 9:30 PM-2:00 AM. This is a free 21+ event where musicians and performers can showcase their talents in an intimate punk rock-inspired venue.
event_venue_information:
About Strummer's

Named in honor of deceased punk rock visionary and frontman of The Clash Joe Strummer this concert venue has become a cornerstone of Fresno's live music scene. The venue features a modern and intimate atmosphere perfect for catching touring acts and local talent.

Regular Events

Strummer's hosts live music concerts throughout the week featuring rock punk alternative and various other genres. The Tuesday night open mic and karaoke has become a beloved tradition for local musicians and karaoke enthusiasts.

Venue Features

This standing-room venue can hold up to 400 people and features two full-service bars professional sound equipment and a stage that brings performers and audiences together. The venue regularly hosts both touring acts from around the country and local Fresno bands.

title: Sunday Night Blues Jam @ Club One Casino
event_description: Monthly blues jam session featuring the Richie Blue Band with special guests. All musicians are welcome to sit in and play the blues in a casual supportive environment. This free event brings together blues enthusiasts and players.
event_venue_information:
About Club One Casino

Club One Casino is a 51-table cardroom casino open 24/7/365 located in the Granite Park area of Fresno. Beyond gaming the venue has become known for its live entertainment offerings including regular music events on the outdoor patio.

Music & Entertainment

The casino hosts a variety of live music events including the popular Sunday Night Blues Jam series. The venue features a full bar and restaurant serving until 3 AM and shows all major sporting and pay-per-view events on large video walls.

Facilities

With multiple bars including a gorgeous outdoor patio for dining and events Club One Casino provides a unique atmosphere for live music. The venue is conveniently located off the 168 freeway just minutes from Fresno Yosemite International Airport.

title: Jazz Jam Session @ Tap & Cellar
event_description: Monthly jazz jam session where musicians gather to play standards and improvise together. This event welcomes jazz players of all skill levels in a relaxed craft beer and wine bar setting.
event_venue_information:
About Tap & Cellar

Tap & Cellar is Fresno's premier craft beer and wine restaurant tucked away in the Pinedale Business Complex just north of Alluvial and Ingram. The venue travels the state to bring the best craft beers available including Alvarado St Brewing Co Humble Sea Brewing Co and Moonraker.

Live Music Scene

The venue hosts live music most Thursday Friday and Saturday nights starting around 8 PM. Beyond concerts Tap & Cellar has become a gathering spot for jazz musicians who meet for monthly jam sessions creating an intimate musical experience.

Food & Drink

Tap & Cellar features 25 rotating craft beers on tap alongside a carefully curated wine selection from local vineyards and renowned regions like Napa and Calistoga. The menu includes flatbreads pizzas charcuterie boards and rotating food specials. The venue offers both indoor seating and a charming outdoor patio.
